notes.title: V1.4.5 - Major Changes + Upcoming Updates
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Added a match ending screen. Winning team will be able to show off dance moves and stats.
- Fixed Zombies issue when a round doesn't want to continue. Players will not be able to join a game mid-match.
- Fixed match history not displaying kills/score and winning color etc.
- Fixed the take down when knifing an enemy from behind. It would cause a double death animation and at times it wouldn't completely work when knifing behind.
- Added Stormy female character.
- Zombies weapon slot from random box will now enter the correct slot. No more stacking primaries in all slots.
- Created vehicle functionality (no vehicle available in this update).

[h2]Upcoming:[/h2]
- Graphical update on Hangar map - will repeat on other maps if all goes well with optimization etc.
- New map
- New killstreak system with 3 selectable and more killstreaks.
- Vehicles to be implemented
- Weapon perks unlocks
- Prone collider into surfaces
- BR mode
- Twitch gameplay changer
- Inventory system

As you can tell I am still working on all the issues and addressing the community concerns via Discord. Please keep the suggestions coming. Enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Version 1.2.3 - Last 2020 Update
notes.notes:
Drop us a quick comment or feedback. I'd love to hear from people on how we're doing with updates and what they want to see in the future. Happy new years to all. We'll be working hard in 2021 to make further improvements.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Fixed 2nd Zombie game not able to start the wave.
- Fixed Zombie audio if you were not host of the game.
- Fixed Zombies falling through the ground.
- Fixed Zombies death animation (they used to just disappear).
- Added when player is knocked in Zombies between waves they will automatically be changed to alive state.

[h1]Some exciting items coming in Zombies:[/h1]
- Quest Mode / Unlockable areas
- New Zombie animations to give the game a better realistic approach instead of aiming your gun in a straight line.
- New Zombie types. Thanks @Gamga & @Krissoge for the detailed concept. We'll be implementing this. Zombie boss will be every 5 waves.

    NORMAL
        - normal dmg
        - normal speed
        - normal hp
    AGILE
        - reduces hp
        - slightly more speed
        - climbing attributes
        - tries to avoids bullets
    EXPLOSIVE
        - fast
        - explodes on contact or if too close
    RANGE
        - vomits projectiles at the player
        - projectiles slow the player
    FAST
        - a sonic boi
        - poisons the player (tick dmg for X seconds)
    TANKY - BOSS (spawns each 5th wave)
        - improved hp
        - normal speed

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - We're Listening
notes.notes:
Hello Community,

I personally wanted to reach out to everyone and say thank you for the reviews. The positive ones make us feel great inside. The negative ones will make us grow into the video game everyone wanted. Even when someone says the game is "very bad dog dooo dooo", we hear you, we may disagree with that review because we know we're working hard for the end goal. 

The reason we made this game free was to show the community how far we can come from the starting phases to our roadmap that will never end.

I promise you, we're listening, we're updating and going to make this a game that you will all enjoy. Advise you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/9hthxhj]official Discord[/url] if you have any bugs or issues with the game.

Enjoy the new update and here is the changelog:

- Deeper optimization on maps for a better frame rate. *Still needs more work, but players should be seeing a slight improvement.
- Deeper optimization on operators to render less. Increased frame rate.
- Added a winning (green) / losing (red) / tie (yellow) circle in HUD for TDM, DOM & CTF.
- Fixed some known areas where players could escape the map.
- Decreased domination capture points when taking a point.
- Adjusted gun trial game mode with the first initial gun provided.
- Steam Achievements implemented.
- Adjusted the player jump sound.
- Fixed kill feed not displaying on some resolutions.
- Yard map temporarily removed until further optimization.
- Fixed domination cover point not fulfilling the entire circle.
- UI fixes.
- Nerfed the LSAT.
- Fixed the pivot point of flag in CTF.
- Added rank image on scoreboard in the game mode.
- Rollout of scope fixes
- Fixed CTF bug where it was out of /150 on HUD.
- Fixed quality settings not being able to change from main menu.
- Increased weapon pickup to stay for the entire game until picked up by a player.
- Fixed team mate bot killing in CTF.
- Fixed party issue with usernames that had a hyphen in their name.
- Added Discord API so it'll update that you're playing War Identity.
